name: voron-stealthburner-r2-interactive-manual
description: Interactive 3D assembly manual for the VORON Stealthburner toolhead and Clockwork 2.5 extruder, built from the official STEP. Independent community project, not affiliated with VORON Design.

scripts.setup: uv venv --python 3.12 .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python cadquery-ocp==8.0.1.1.0
scripts.step: mkdir -p build/ph && .venv/bin/python tools/step/convert_ocp.py source/Stealthburner_CW2.5_Assembly.step build/assembly-main.json 0.1 0.4 && for f in source/printheads/*.step; do .venv/bin/python tools/step/convert_ocp.py $f build/ph/$(basename $f .step).json 0.1 0.4; done && node tools/step/merge.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:hardware && npm run build:data && npm run build:page
scripts.build:all: npm run step && npm run build

author: Mairis Skuja (Iconic FAB)
